problem_metadata.title: Block on a rough incline
problem_metadata.notes: A block of mass m is placed on an incline with angle θ and kinetic friction coefficient μ.

derivation_steps.explanation: Correct force balance along the incline.
The normal force is mg cosθ, not mg sinθ. You used sin(θ) where cos(θ) belongs.
derivation_steps.socratic_hint: Look perpendicular to the incline. Is the normal force mg·sinθ or mg·cosθ?
derivation_steps.socratic_hint_hinglish: Incline ke perpendicular direction dekho. Normal force mg·sinθ hai ya mg·cosθ?
